label: BOJ Policy Rate
delta: Held at 1.00%; Sept 18 hike widely expected
deltaNote: Highest since September 1995. BOJ held rate at its July 31 meeting; after Q2 GDP was revised up to an annualized 1.4% (from 1.1%) on Sept 7, swap markets priced a ~98% probability of a 25bp hike to 1.25% at the Sept 18, 2026 meeting, with a further move to 1.5% largely priced in by January 2027

label: Yen / US Dollar
deltaNote: Yen strengthened roughly 3.6% over the past month to its firmest level in about 7 months, as markets priced a near-certain BOJ rate hike on Sept 18 following the upward Q2 GDP revision. A stronger yen weighed on exporters, pulling the Nikkei 225 down modestly to ~65,143 on Sept 9
